NSHealthShareUsageDescription: getdailyme reads your steps, exercise minutes and sleep to log them automatically into the activities you choose.
NSHealthUpdateUsageDescription: getdailyme does not write data to Health; this permission is declared by the health library.
NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: getdailyme needs access to your photo library to attach a photo to your logs.
NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: getdailyme needs permission to save images you generate from the app.
NSCameraUsageDescription: getdailyme needs camera access to take a photo for your log.
NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: getdailyme does not use your location. This permission is required by a notifications library, but the app never accesses your location.
